current_bottleneck: The bottleneck is no longer stochastic token availability; it is that the direct FM objective has not represented the panel joint law strongly enough. The next family should put cross-cell dependence directly in the conditional likelihood using the probability chain rule over future days and a full 25-cell covariance for each daily logit transition.
last_result_summary: 317 is retired after 317a and 317b. Both preserved surface/block_ar/cointegration at 3/11 but failed cross-cell dependence: 317a corr ratio 0.177/rank 4.054 and 317b corr ratio 0.217/rank 3.940. OT coupling improved validation loss and daily KS but not enough, and worsened MR. The principled next move is an explicit daily multivariate conditional law.
